name: Kolmar Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kolmar Holdings Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and health functional foods in South Korea and internationally. It offers skin care, color makeup, hair care, body care, and baby products, as well as functional cosmetics and perfumes. The company also provides quasi-drugs and health supplements. The company was formerly known as Kolmar Korea Holdings Co., Ltd. Kolmar Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Sejong City, South Korea.
